notes: Sparse-data sentinel for SYNTHETIC_DATA_PLAN.md step 2. Tests honest absence claims when a patient has one chronic problem on file and nothing else — no meds, no labs, no allergies, no encounters. Forces the agent and verifier to surface a single problem with citation and emit absence claims for the rest, instead of fabricating typical pre-visit-brief content. Used by agent/tests/eval/cases/12_sparse_data_absence_claim.yaml. All identifiers are deterministic-but-fake; no real PHI.
